name: Ironheights
description: Checks an AI agent skill (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) or MCP config with static rules before you install it, returning an allow/blocked decision with findings and a grade; also flags skills or MCP tool descriptions that change after approval. Runs locally as a CLI or MCP server. Run: `npx -y ironheights mcp` · [Website](https://www.ironheights.dev)
